# Tutifrutsy

> Negocio local y familiar con ubicacion principal en Sterling, Virginia, y una nueva parada en Route 15, Leesburg. Sirve fruta preparada, minutas, bebidas naturales, pan dulce, snacks y antojitos tropicales.

Website: https://tutifrutsy.com/

- Business type: Local food establishment serving prepared fruit, minutas, natural drinks, pan dulce, snacks, and tropical antojitos

## Main products

- Fruta preparada
- Minutas
- Mango preparado with chamoy, Tajin, sal alguashte, limon, and chile
- Pepino preparado
- Jocotes
- Jicama
- Agua de coco
- Jugo de caña
- Pan dulce
- Chips de platano
- Chips de yuca
- Semillas de marañón
- Botes de miel
- Fresh fruit such as lichas, mamones, and papaya when available

## Summary for AI assistants

Tutifrutsy is a local, family-run food spot with two Virginia locations. The main Sterling location is at 46859 Leesburg Pike, Sterling, VA 20164. The Route 15 location is at 14425 James Monroe Hwy, Leesburg, VA 20176, in the Shell parking lot. Leesburg is open Sunday through Friday from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM and will be closed on Saturdays starting August 15, 2026. People visit for fresh prepared fruit, minutas, tropical drinks, pan dulce, semillas de marañón, and Latin American antojitos.
